title: Broadcast path: blow the Collegium open

choices.text: Warden’s Reckoning — she leads the public remaking of the Collegium
choices.textHot: Warden’s Reckoning — lead the remaking with his heat at your back and daylight teeth

warm:
Assembly Hall did not forgive soft voices, and [player_name] had none left to offer. Copper ward-bells hung like a crown that had learned to listen for fracture and for scandal. Salt wind pressed the high leaded glass. Ozone clung to stone ribs. She stood on the speaking dais with living-key language in her mouth and Cassian Rook a half-step behind her left shoulder—scorched leather, blade-oil, brutal charm filed to public steel.

“Blow it open,” she had told him in the corridor. Broadcast path. No more managed stories. No more quiet burns wearing nicer coats. Isolde Vane occupied the Headmistress’s balcony as if the air itself had been invoiced. Maris Quill sat pale among candidates. Bram Kestrel watched from the shelf-side door. Prefects coughed into badges. Lord Vesper Thorne remained absent temperature—warm wine over broken glass—still unfinished as monster or revolutionary while romance locked on Cassian alone.

[player_name] named the living-key cost into every loud mouth Ashmere owned. Century singers. Quiet burns. Dual-consent bowls Isolde preferred lonely. Mercy rewrites Bram half-translated. Prefect courier ash. Recognition without confirmation where genealogy blanks still refused her name. She did not invent belonging. She invented volume.

The gallery inhaled like a wound. Copper bells tasted the words and found fracture they could not tidy into dining-hall rumor. Isolde’s smile thinned. “Theater has consequences.”

“Good,” Cassian murmured for [player_name] alone. “Consequences that stay public are harder to burn quiet. Lead the remaking—Warden’s Reckoning, you at the front of Collegium reform with teeth. Or Open Secret—let Calderyn know the living-key cost and endure the noise together without pretending silence was ever mercy.”

Living-key payoff deepened into daylight architecture: Calderyn’s thinning farms, aurora-glass markets, border villages hearing Unmade whispers first—all of it suddenly invited into Ashmere’s buried teeth. Hope and dread shared the doorway louder than any private bargain. Thorne’s leftover frequency rented more corridor space the moment truth got loud. That was the cost of broadcast. That was also the point.

Maris’s hand found her bench edge. Bram’s shelf-door stayed open like an accusation of courage. A prefect flinched toward escape grammar and found Cassian’s eyes already there. [player_name]’s cracked charm ticked bruise-blue. Mid-want hummed unfinished under duty—adult, consequential, refused as weakness.

“Eyes open,” she told the hall. “I blew the Collegium open. Living-key sacrifice is architecture, not bedtime hymn. The Unmade still presses without tidy martyrdom. Thorne still unfinished. I will not let Isolde’s patience rewrite volume into shame. I choose the next verb while my mouth is still mine.”

Isolde rose. “Then choose. Lead remaking and inherit every invoice. Or endure open secret and inherit every rumor inland. Both irreversible. Soft is dead.”

Cassian’s glove brushed her wrist—person-claim not key-claim. Heat leapt. “I walk either. I do not walk a third where we pretend broadcast already finished wanting for us.” Salt wind rattled glass. Fog climbed cliff stairs. She gathered breath, stance, charm. Warden’s Reckoning or Open Secret. Partnership under apocalypse pressure. Consequence first.

Salt wind fretted Ashmere’s stone again. Copper bells tasted fracture and kept their tongues restless. [player_name]’s cracked charm ticked against her throat like a second, stubborn pulse. Inland, Calderyn’s farmlands failed in quiet increments where outer wards thinned; aurora-glass markets dimmed; border villages heard Unmade whispers first. Archivist Bram Kestrel’s half-translated hymns still suggested refusal might be possible without proving what refusal cost. Maris Quill’s friend-fear walked corridors without needing a body. Cassian’s ashwood drawer stayed shut on a past that included nearly following Lord Vesper Thorne—hints deepened here, full dump still refused where mercy mattered.

The Unmade pressed like weather that had learned names. Thorne’s mark on the cliff face stayed wet as monster, revolutionary, or both. Romance locked on Cassian Rook alone: mid-thirties battlemage, brutal charm, scorched leather, practice-blade oil, partnership under apocalypse pressure. Ozone from spent braids clung to stone. Chalk circles smeared by rain glowed faint blue. Veil Sea fog climbed the cliff stairs. Mid-want hummed unfinished beneath duty while consequence-verbs waited to be spoken with eyes open.

[player_name] catalogued the hinge the way she catalogued fracture: location, intensity, ask. Recognition without ownership where the ink still stopped. Pattern without tidy martyrdom. Soft was never the offer under apocalypse pressure. Hope and dread shared the doorway. Person first. Key never only.
 The hinge asked: Warden’s Reckoning, or Open Secret.
